title: Guidewire Acquires Hyperexponential in $1.7B Cash Deal
excerpt: Guidewire has agreed to purchase Hyperexponential for $1.7 billion in cash to integrate AI agents into underwriting and pricing.
body_html:
Guidewire has announced the acquisition of Hyperexponential in a cash transaction valued at $1.7 billion. The agreement is scheduled to close next year.

According to the companies, the purchase is aimed at incorporating artificial intelligence agents into workplace tasks. These AI tools are intended to collaborate with human workers on underwriting, analysis, and pricing decisions.
